# Support

- Installation, usage, and design questions: [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/cloudguo123/mac-parallel-accelerator/discussions)
- Reproducible defects: [bug report](https://github.com/cloudguo123/mac-parallel-accelerator/issues/new?template=bug.yml)
- Real-project results: [benchmark report](https://github.com/cloudguo123/mac-parallel-accelerator/issues/new?template=benchmark.yml)
- Vulnerabilities: use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/cloudguo123/mac-parallel-accelerator/security/advisories/new), not a public issue

Remove secrets, personal paths, prompts, project content, and private logs before sharing any public report.
